examples.arabic: اشار الرجل الى اليمين وقال اذهب مباشرة ثم انعطف يسارا ستجده هناك
examples.english: The man pointed to the right and said, 'Go straight, then turn left, you will find it there.'
examples.transliteration: Ashara ar-rajul ila al-yamin wa qala idhhab mubasharatan thumma in'atif yasaran sa-tajiduhu hunak.

examples.arabic: يشير الرجل الى اليمين ثم اقول شكرا جزيلا
examples.english: The man points to the right, then I say, 'Thank you very much.'
examples.transliteration: Yashir al-rajul ila al-yamin thumma aqul: shukran jazilan.
